about: The crypt's Ossuary niches (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB13): a fight room, a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones; its landmark its north side, a wall of stacked bones along the lip broken by two niches, each heaped with bones and skulls, candles lit before them. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), held straight under its sockets (west, east, south) and behind the bone wall by pins. tools/ground_shape.py draws arena_14_ground.tscn and its art from this.
